title: Turning the Tables: Biased, Imbalanced, Dynamic Tabular Datasets for ML Evaluation
reasoning: The paper focuses on creating a dataset to evaluate 'fairness' in ML methods, which is a core ethical concern in AI. The entire suite of datasets is designed with controllable bias patterns to specifically evaluate algorithmic fairness, making this a central component of the paper, not just a brief section.
